title: Verb vocabulary
description: The project's own verbs and the built-in verbs it hides (verbs-design.md decisions 6 to 8): one file per project, model/vocabularies/verbs.json.

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

excludeStereotypes.description: Stereotype keys that a database schema's or a package's defaultStereotypes would give this element, left out with the stereotypes they imply. Only defaults can be excluded (MQ2029).

hidden.description: Built-in verbs the project does not use: the editor does not offer them and model.verbs leaves them out unless named (MQ9704). Each must be a built-in verb's key (MQ9703).

verbs.description: The project's own verbs, in file order. Every use names one by its key; renaming one in use goes through the batch operation rename-verb (MQ9707).

key.description: The kebab-case key every use names; neither a built-in verb's nor another own verb's (MQ9702).

displayName.description: The label (localizable); absent, the key with its first letter upper case and hyphens as spaces.

description.description: The meaning a pack or an implementer fills in (localizable).
